data.title: Weather Forecast for Saturday
data.content:
Riyadh, November 21, 2026, SPA -- The National Center for Meteorology (NCM) forecasts thunderstorms, accompanied by hail, with a chance of fog forming in parts of Jazan, Aseer, Al-Baha, and Makkah regions. Dust-stirring winds are also expected in parts of these regions, as well as in parts of Madinah Region.
    Over the Red Sea, winds will be northeasterly to northwesterly at speeds of 10–35 km/h in the northern part, northeasterly to northerly at speeds of 10–33 km/h in the central part, and southeasterly to southwesterly at speeds of 10–35 km/h in the southern part.
    In the Arabian Gulf, winds will be northwesterly to northerly at speeds of 10–35 km/h in the northern part and northwesterly to westerly at speeds of 10–38 km/h in the southern part.
    -- SPA
